sections.description:
ShopGlut Single Product Page Builder is the ultimate solution for creating stunning, high-converting WooCommerce product pages. With our intuitive drag-and-drop interface and advanced customization options, you can design professional product layouts that boost sales and enhance user experience.

🚀 Why Choose ShopGlut Single Product Builder?

Transform boring default WooCommerce product pages into conversion-optimized masterpieces that engage customers and drive sales. Our builder offers unprecedented control over every aspect of your product page design.

⭐ Key Benefits:
✅ Zero Coding Required – Visual drag-and-drop interface for everyone
✅ Conversion Optimized – Layouts designed to maximize sales
✅ Mobile Responsive – Perfect on all devices automatically
✅ Lightning Fast – Performance-optimized for speed
✅ SEO Friendly – Built-in schema markup and optimization
✅ Theme Compatible – Works with any WordPress theme

🎨 DRAG-AND-DROP VISUAL BUILDER

Intuitive Design Interface:
* Live Preview – See changes instantly as you design
* Drag-and-Drop Sections – Move elements anywhere with ease
* Visual Column Builder – Create custom layouts with flexible columns
* Template Library – Professional pre-designed layouts to start with
* Responsive Controls – Perfect design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
* Undo/Redo Functionality – Never lose your work

Advanced Layout System:

* Two Column Layout – Traditional left/right column arrangement
* Three Column Layout – Advanced multi-section layouts (Pro)
* Custom Grid System – Flexible column widths and spacing
* Container Controls – Full width, boxed, wide, or narrow containers

📱 FLEXIBLE LAYOUT OPTIONS

Multiple Layout Types:
* Single Column – Streamlined vertical product presentation
* Two Column – Classic gallery + info layout with customizable ratios
* Sidebar Layouts – Add promotional content and related products
* Mobile-First Design – Automatic mobile optimization with custom breakpoints

Column Customization:

* Custom Spacing – Control gaps between columns and sections
* Background Colors – Individual background colors for each column
* Padding Controls – Fine-tune spacing inside columns

🧩 COMPREHENSIVE SECTION LIBRARY

Product Information Sections:
* Product Images – Advanced gallery with zoom, thumbnails, and lightbox
* Product Title – Customizable headings with typography controls
* Product Price – Styled pricing with sale price highlighting

* Grid Thumbnails – Customizable thumbnail grid (2-6 columns)

Flexible Tab Management:

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):
1. Go to your WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
2. Search for “ShopGlut Single Product Page Builder”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
4. Navigate to ShopGlut → Single Product Builder to start designing

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Upload via WordPress admin or extract to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Activate through the Plugins menu
4. Access the builder through ShopGlut admin menu

Quick Setup:
1. After activation, go to ShopGlut → Single Product Builder
2. Create your first layout using the visual builder
3. Choose products to apply the layout to
4. Customize colors, fonts, and spacing to match your brand
5. Preview on mobile and desktop
6. Publish your enhanced product pages

System Requirements:
* WordPress 5.1+ (6.0+ recommended)
* WooCommerce 3.0+ (latest version recommended)
* PHP 7.4+ (8.0+ recommended)
* MySQL 5.6+ or MariaDB 10.0+
* Memory limit: 128MB+ (256MB+ recommended)
sections.faq:
Is coding knowledge required to use this plugin?

No! The plugin is designed for users of all skill levels. The drag-and-drop interface makes it easy to create professional product pages without any coding knowledge.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. ShopGlut is performance-optimized with conditional loading, efficient database queries, and modern caching techniques. Most users see improved performance due to better code optimization.

Does it work with variable products?

Absolutely! The plugin fully supports all WooCommerce product types including simple, variable, grouped, and external products with specialized layouts for each type.

Is the plugin mobile-responsive?

Yes! All layouts are mobile-first and automatically optimize for tablets and smartphones. You can also customize mobile-specific settings.

Can I customize colors and fonts?

Yes! The plugin includes comprehensive customization options for colors, typography, spacing, and layout. Pro version adds advanced styling options including gradients and Google Fonts.

Does it work with my theme?

ShopGlut is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme. The plugin integrates seamlessly without conflicting with your theme’s design.

Can I preview changes before publishing?

Yes! The builder includes live preview functionality so you can see exactly how your product pages will look before making them live.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro versions?

The free version includes all core functionality for most stores. Pro adds advanced templates, three-column layouts, enhanced animations, conditional display rules, and priority support.

Do you provide customer support?

Yes! We offer support through WordPress.org forums for free users and priority support for Pro users through our dedicated support portal.
